body.p: A mouse and a reindeer lived in the same land. One day they met one another. It was very sunny on that day. The mouse said to the reindeer: "What are you doing here?" The reindeer said: "I am running and looking for something to eat, and you, what are you doing?" The mouse said: "I don't want to do anything on a day like this." The mouse said: "Who are you?" "I am the reindeer who lives in the tundra. And who are you?" The mouse said: "I am small and one can't see me from the ground." The mouse said: "Let's play! I will hide, and you will look for me." The reindeer laughed, one could hear it all over the forest. The mouse said: "Don't laugh, later you hide and I will look for you." The reindeer said: "Look for me!" The reindeer ran away and lay down on the ground. The mouse looked, looked, it got tired, it lay down. It lies and thinks: "I will trick you." It stood up and shouted very loudly: "Reindeer, stand up, I see you, you hid your whole body, but your antlers are visible." The reindeer lied, lied and thought: "I forgot to hide my antlers." The reindeer stood up and ran to the mouse. The reindeer said: "Now you hide." The mouse ran away and hid in the reindeer moss. The reindeer looks and looks, but cannot find it. It can't find it in any way; it wanted to eat and started eating the reindeer moss. The reindeer eats and eats and swallowed the mouse with the reindeer moss. After it finished eating, it lay down. While it was lying like this, the mouse tore its intestine open with its teeth and got out. It made a hole and went out. The little reindeer put its head on the ground, closed its eyes and died. The mouse shouted loudly, strongly: "Hey, come here, bear and all the animals, being a little one I killed such a big reindeer." From all parts of the earth (sides) the animals came. They started eating the reindeer. The mouse said: "I am tired; I will go and lie down. Leave some food for me."[ShA:] KajizaÊ is not expected It fell asleep. The mouse got up. It went to the place where it had killed (the reindeer).here, kajiraÊ is expected.[ShA:] Ka- is die, kaza- is expected for kill.But there was nothing there. Just bones lay everywhere. There was no meat. After this affair the mouse got angry, dug a hole for herself and no longer speaks with anyone. After that, the animals live by themselves. They do not know each other. The reindeer does not know the mouse and the mouse does not know the reindeer.
